chunks: And Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who freed part of his slave, he said: “He is entirely free; Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has no partner.”

key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for Allah; referring here to Allah in the legal rationale

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone frees only part of a slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a man frees part of his slave, the slave becomes fully free. The wording grounds the ruling in tawhid, affirming that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has no partner.
